name: Sculpfun S30 Ultra 10W
tagline: Entry S30 Ultra frame : engraving-first, light cutting
tldr: The 10W S30 Ultra uses the same rigid frame as higher-power models but targets makers who mainly engrave wood, leather, and slate. Expect slower cuts and thinner material limits than the 20W or 22W versions.

priceRange.note: 10W module : still sold as a distinct SKU

pros: 10W on Sculpfun S30 Ultra: engraving-first : photo fills and leather at moderate speeds
Open-frame : plan laser glasses, exhaust, and workspace rules from day one
Software on the profile : trial your workflow on scrap before production
cons: Clear cast acrylic and thick production cutting still favor CO₂, not diode power alone

beginnerNotes: This profile is the 10W SKU on Sculpfun S30 Ultra. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Run material test grids at engraving speeds first. Add air assist for light cuts. If cut jobs exceed ~30% of your week, open the higher-watt profile on this site and compare times.
mainObjective: High-quality hobby and light-business engraving with light, slow cutting

editorialDepth.advantages: Sculpfun S30 Ultra 10W suits makers who sell marks, photos, and gifts more than daily panel cutting. Reasonable open-frame entry price.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if you already quote 5 mm+ cutting in production : see 20W or 22W in the line. Not for cast acrylic or bare metal without spray.
